C1276.title: Podesta Phishing Email Incident (U.S. Election Emailgate)
C1276.summary: On March 19, 2016, Hillary campaign chair John Podesta received an email disguised as a Google security warning claiming someone was trying to access his account and urging a password change. His aide forwarded it to an IT staffer, who misjudged it as a 'legitimate email' due to a typo; Podesta clicked the phishing link, causing roughly 6,000 emails over nearly a decade to be stolen and later leaked via WikiLeaks. Attackers used Bitly short URLs resembling Google and were attributed to the Russian hacking group Fancy Bear.

references.title: A Review of the 'Email Gate' Incident During the U.S. Election Year - National Information Center
